n6bc52589bf.headline: Fewer and Fewer Romanians Can Afford to Set Money Aside. Only One in Four Says They Are Doing Well Financially
n6bc52589bf.summary: Only 26% of Romanians say they pay their bills without worry and still have money left to save or spend, down 2.5 points from last year, according to a PwC survey.
n6bc52589bf.why: Household financial health drives consumer spending, a major share of economic activity. Survey data helps investors gauge demand in consumer-facing sectors.

n219804641f.headline: This company wins UAE work worth over Rs 4,000 crore; share price up 247% in 5 years
n219804641f.summary: Kalpataru Projects International has been awarded work worth over Rs 4,000 crore in the UAE. The company's shares have also performed well over the past year.
n219804641f.why: Kalpataru Projects International is an Indian engineering and infrastructure contractor with large overseas construction and transmission projects. Major contract wins can signal future revenue visibility.

n6e91b471e3.headline: Protesters hold vigils in 23 cities over housing law in Spain
n6e91b471e3.summary: Protests over an eviction have grown into a national outcry, with vigils held in 23 cities across Spain. The demonstrations are directed at the country's housing law.
n6e91b471e3.why: Housing policy in Spain affects rental markets, property values and lenders. Regulatory changes to tenancy and eviction rules can shift real estate investment conditions.
